releases.notes:
### **Added many features including (but not limited to):**
- Tuff Block Set
- Dripstone Block Set
- Soul Sandstone
- Storage Blocks for Bulk Items
- Stairs, Slabs & Walls for Vanilla Blocks
- Chest Wood Types
- Ladder Wood Types
- Bookshelf Wood Types
- Fixed custom and vanilla bone block variant recipes
- Added trapped variant of Jineric Chests
- Added recipe for wavy red sandstone
- Added missing stone cutter recipes for some blocks
- Fix bug with egg block glowing

* Fixed crash upon launch  by @Jiingy in https://github.com/Jiingy/Jineric-Mod/pull/84

* Updated to beta v5.0.0 1.19.4 by @Jiingy in https://github.com/Jiingy/Jineric-Mod/pull/90

releases.notes:
__**Added**__
Added Features:
- Slate now generates naturally underground
- Borite now generates naturally underground
- All of soul sandstone/sandstone/siltstone blocks/walls/stairs/slabs are craftable in both crafting bench & stone cutter
- All new storage blocks are craftable with their respective items

Updated Block Textures:
- Soul jack o' lantern
- Charcoal block
- Flint block

Added Blocks:
- Smooth stone stairs/walls
- Siltstone/Polished siltstone   (Both with wall/stair/slabs)
- Borite   (with stairs/slabs/walls. Still not craftable yet. Texture is WIP)
- Slate   (with stairs/slabs/walls. Still not craftable yet. Name subject to change)
- Boreal planks/slabs/stairs (no functionality yet)
